Chapters guide

Chapter 4: Vice City, Baby — GTA 6 progression guide

The pair are established in Vice City and build toward the VCIA Takedown, an airport heist assembled through security work, surveillance, disguises and vehicle thefts for their contacts. The chapter closes with the heist's aftermath and the pair effectively starting over.

Missions — what sources report

KeenGamer and GameRant both count 25 main missions, opening with Ocean Beach. Dexerto's verified list ends the chapter with Sunset followed by a finale whose name it withholds as a spoiler; the name 'Starting From Zero' used by some guides does not appear in that verified list and is unverified. The optional list matters here: KeenGamer files both the time-sensitive 'This Is a Free Call From…' and the vault-unlocking 'That's Where The Money Is…' in this chapter.

What unlocks

  • Large bank vault robberies via the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) — confirmed as an end-of-Chapter 4 unlock by PowerPyx's 100% guide; some guides file vaults under Chapter 5 because the feature sits on the chapter boundary
  • Thompson Court Garage, free with 2 spaces (after Company Cars)
  • Pilot Pete delivery jobs paying $10,000–$20,000, Jason only (Chapter 4, per GTABase via HeistAtlas)
  • Yasmani's security-van tips for vault runs ($10,000, after robbing two Payday Loans stores)

Free grabs this act

  • Thompson Court Garage (free, story, 2 vehicle spaces)
  • Squalo boat (Ultimate Edition — reported as a Chapter 4-window item, so claim it in this chapter rather than deferring)

Warnings & traps

  • Vaults unlock at the very end of this chapter via the optional cafe mission — despite some guides filing them under Chapter 5, plan to unlock them here, before the finale questline, not mid-chapter
  • Every vault run triggers an instant four-star wanted level the moment you enter
  • 'This Is a Free Call From…' (Lucia) is a time-sensitive missable in this chapter
  • Do not rush into VCIA Takedown until the available preparation missions are done (KeenGamer)
  • Ultimate Edition items reported as chapter-windowed (Enduro and kayak in Chapter 1, Squalo here) may not be claimable after their chapter passes

Sources & evidence

Source: GTA 6 Walkthrough: All Chapters and Story Missions in Order — KeenGamer (2026-11-19).

Source: How to Make Money Fast in GTA 6: Best Methods by Chapter — GameMapa (built mainly on PowerPyx) (2026-11-18).

Source: GTA 6 Money Guide: 9 Fastest Ways to Make Money by Chapter — NerdSnack.

Source: GTA 6 Garage Guide: Locations and Prices — Mobalytics (2026-11-21).

Source: GTA 6 Mission List — All Chapters and Missions — Dexerto.

Mission count and the Thompson Court unlock agree across sources. The vault unlock timing is now settled: PowerPyx's 100% guide places it at the end of Chapter 4 (optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe)'); guides filing vaults under Chapter 5 use the chapter boundary differently.
